summary: This Form 6-K filed by Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. announces completion of patient enrollment in its ReSTART pivotal trial for Alpha DaRT therapy to treat recurrent cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. No economic terms, share prices, premiums, or transaction deadlines are provided. The filing describes a clinical milestone toward potential FDA pre-market approval, not a capital markets event or corporate structure change. As a routine update on clinical trial progress with no special-situation characteristics, this filing does not warrant categorization as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The appropriate classification is None.
